items.exampleEn: I stayed up late to finish my report.
Can you take over for a few minutes while I get some water?
items.exampleZh: 我去拿點水，你可以接手幾分鐘嗎？

items.exampleEn: Painting looked fun, so I decided to take it up.
items.exampleZh: 畫畫看起來很好玩，所以我決定開始學。

items.exampleEn: I took the shoes back because they didn't fit.
items.exampleZh: 那雙鞋不合腳，所以我拿去退了。

items.exampleEn: In winter, the water in the lake turns into ice.
items.exampleZh: 冬天時，湖裡的水會變成冰。

items.exampleEn: Did you make a reservation at the hotel?
items.exampleZh: 你有訂那家飯店的房間嗎？

items.exampleEn: It takes ten minutes to get there on foot.

items.sentenceEn: We stayed up all night talking about our trip.
items.sentenceZh: 我們整晚沒睡，一直在聊我們的旅行。

items.audioEn: I'll take the meeting over, so you can leave early.
items.audioZh: 我來接手這場會議，你可以先走。

items.sentenceEn: You need to make a reservation to visit the museum.
items.sentenceZh: 參觀這間博物館需要先預約。

items.sentenceEn: My little hobby turned into a real job.
items.sentenceZh: 我的小嗜好變成了一份真正的工作。

items.stemEn: Last year my mom ____ swimming, and now she goes to class every week.
items.stemZh: 我媽媽去年開始學游泳，現在每週都去上課。

items.stemEn: I called the restaurant to ____ for six people on Friday night.
items.stemZh: 我打電話給餐廳，訂星期五晚上六個人的位子。

items.passageEn: My aunt has a small cafe near the train station. Last year, she wanted to take a long trip, so my cousin Amy took over the cafe for two months. Amy had never worked in a cafe before, so she stayed up late every night to learn how to make coffee. On the first day, she even ran out of milk! Slowly, the quiet cafe turned into a popular place for students. Now people have to make a reservation on weekends. Most of them come on foot because there is no place to park.
items.passageZh: 我阿姨在火車站附近開了一家小咖啡店。去年她想去長途旅行，所以我的表親 Amy 接手這家店兩個月。Amy 以前從沒在咖啡店工作過，所以每天晚上都熬夜學怎麼煮咖啡。第一天她甚至把牛奶用完了！慢慢地，這家冷清的咖啡店變成了學生很喜歡去的地方。現在週末要先訂位。大部分客人都走路來，因為附近沒有地方停車。

questions.questionZh: Amy 為什麼每天晚上熬夜？
為什麼大部分客人走路來？

items.promptZh: 我妹妹考試前常常熬夜。
referenceEn: My sister often stays up late before exams.
My younger sister often stays up late before tests.
rubricZh: 建議用片語，例如 stays up late、stays up 等；不用片語但意思正確（例如 goes to bed very late 等）也算對
常常做的事用現在簡單式；often 可放在一般動詞前或句尾（例如 often stays up 等）
「考試」可寫，例如 exams、tests 等；「妹妹」可寫，例如 sister、younger sister 等

referenceEn: I take back what I just said.
I take back what I said just now.
rubricZh: 建議用片語，例如 take back what I said 等；不用片語但意思正確（例如 withdraw what I said 等）也算對
可寫，例如 I take back、I want to take back、I'd like to take back 等
「剛才說的話」可寫，例如 what I just said、what I said just now 等
